motion.$description: Decision 22, "Draw, then press": lines draw, shapes fill; a press marks completion (scale 1.04 to 1.06, never a bounce); calm in between; amber marks the moment. Reduced motion shows the key frame.

duration.$description: Durations in ms; every one carries its 24 fps and 60 fps frame counts in $extensions.com.cubealgos.frames.

instant.$description: Hover colour, focus ring. Default easing: ease-out.

quick.$description: Button press, small toggles. Default easing: ease-out.

base.$description: Cards, panels, menus. Default easing: settle.

press.$description: The completion press (scale 1.04 to 1.06). Default easing: settle.

echo.$description: The amber echo after a meaningful completion. Default easing: echo.

draw.$description: Lines and outlines being drawn. Default easing: draw.

wipe.$description: Chamfer wipe between screens or scenes (500 ms in, 500 ms out). Default easing: draw.

draw.$description: Things being built: strokes and wipes. Slow start, slow finish.

settle.$description: Things arriving and settling: card text, the press.

echo.$description: The amber echo leaving the mark.

ease-out.$description: Hover, focus and small UI responses.

scale.$description: Press scale, 1.05 by default within the allowed 1.04 to 1.06. Never a bounce (no overshoot).
